en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a landscaped city park with curving gravel paths, manicured lawns, dense trees and shrubs, a small stone tower-like structure on the left, and terraced stairs and balustrades on the right. The sky is softly tinted in pastel colors. Printed text at the top names the location as Riesa on the Elbe River and identifies it as the municipal park (Stadtpark).
